top_signals.title: Scotiabank's Warrier on Hedge Funds' Tough July
top_signals.summary: Mithra Warrier, managing director and global head of financing sales at Scotiabank, joined the program to provide insights as the market approached the close. The discussion highlighted a difficult July for hedge funds, referencing performance data from major firms such as Verition, Balysansy, Schonfeld Partners, Millennium, Point72, and Coatue. The segment focused on the factors contributing to the tough month for these funds and the broader implications for investors and market participants. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Zeus Wallet taken offline after cyberattack, says no customer funds at risk
top_signals.summary: The self-custodial Bitcoin Lightning Network wallet disabled infrastructure after an incident and founder Evan Kaloudis said no customer funds were lost and no Lightning vulnerability was found.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Alphabet Is Seeking Up to $25 Billion From Its Latest Bond Sale
top_signals.summary: Alphabet Inc. is looking to raise as much as $25 billion from its latest US investment-grade bond offering, according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that will test investor appetite for AI-related debt following a July selloff.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
